Package eu.algites.lib.data.smartdataobject

Record Class AIcdSmartDataValidationIssue

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
eu.algites.lib.data.smartdataobject.AIcdSmartDataValidationIssue
Record Components:
path - technical path to the invalid value
code - stable validation code
message - original diagnostic text for the issue
ownerType - Java type declaring the affected property, when available
propertyName - canonical name of the affected property, when available
fieldDescription - default explanatory text of the field, when available
nestedIssue - optional nested validation issue produced by an embedded value
All Implemented Interfaces:
eu.algites.lib.common.validation.AIiValidationIssue, AIiSdoValidationIssue
public record AIcdSmartDataValidationIssue(String path, String code, String message, Class<?> ownerType, String propertyName, String fieldDescription, eu.algites.lib.common.validation.AIiValidationIssue nestedIssue) extends Record implements AIiSdoValidationIssue
Validation diagnostic with optional originating field and nested issue context.
